beats.text: Could a buyer find [the reason to choose you] in your proposal?
Open your last proposal. Then open a rival's.
Why choose you. What proves it. What you promise to deliver.
Blank on the reason? That's a [positioning] question.
Reason clear, but delivery breaks it? Fix delivery first.
Neither one proves you need a rebrand.

end.title: Find the gap before you brief anyone.
